title: The best things in open source are built together
author: Katie Liu
description: Introducing Replica and the Open Source Accessibility Framework, new open source projects for collaboration and inclusion. The post The best things in open source are built together appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: In 2026, public contributions on GitHub soared to 2.5 billion , more than double last year’s total of 1.12 billion. It goes to show how open source remains a powerful mechanism for developers to build, share, and grow communities.
takeaways: A few weeks ago, GitHub’s design team introduced Replica , which considers the role of designers in the era of AI and focuses on reinforcement learning.
And I’m really excited how, at GitHub, we care so deeply about open source.” Replica, a new open-source design harness In 2025, 60% of the top growing open source projects were AI focused.
GitHub Replica does a lot of reinforcement learning.
